entities.name: Ebtisam Abdul Aziz
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ebtisam Abdulaziz is a contemporary Emirati artist and writer born and raised in Sharjah, UAE. She works with geometry and mathematics to address issues of belonging and identity through installations, performance art and other media.
